    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[3]),int(m[4])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows) and k not in G:
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def f(g,K):
    a=np.array(g); H,W=a.shape
    # dominant non-background color = the one forming long lines; use the minority... 
    # determine colors: two colors. The "shape" color is the one that appears in full runs. Count colors
    vals,cnt=np.unique(a,return_counts=True)
    bg=int(vals[np.argmax(cnt)]); shp=int(vals[np.argmin(cnt)])
    out=a.copy()
    def scan(arr,val,out2):
        for i in range(H):
            j=0
            while j<W:
                if arr[i][j]==val:
                    k=j+1
                    while k<W and arr[i][k]==val: k+=1
                    if k-j>=K: out2[i,j:k]=2
                    j=k
                else: j+=1
        for j in range(W):
            i=0
            while i<H:
                if arr[i][j]==val:
                    k=i+1
                    while k<H and arr[k][j]==val: k+=1
                    if k-i>=K: out2[i:k,j]=2
                    i=k
                else: i+=1
    scan(a,shp,out)
    return out.tolist()
